claim_boundary: Post-review exact small-sector simulation of QE, OVP-only and mixed CEO with a common optimizer. Existing original outcomes informed corrections; no blind preregistration, cross-platform bitwise identity, optimized CEO circuit, finite-shot, hardware, global-optimum or quantum-advantage claim. Config carries no solver outcome.
